1.content:
# Camunda 8.7 — Zeebe Processing & Latency

Ported from the Camunda Grafana dashboard `8.7.35-zeebe.json`. Metrics are expected in Grail as **Micrometer meter names** (`zeebe.stream.processor.records.total`), pushed straight from Camunda over OTLP with `delta` temporality — see `runbook-dynatrace.md`.

**Companion dashboards:** `8.7-zeebe-01-overview.json` · `8.7-zeebe-03-storage.json` · `8.7-zeebe-04-cluster.json` · `8.7-zeebe-05-resources.json`

2.content:
## Processing
Stream processor and exporter progress, positions and lag.

3.title: Processing Queue size
3.query:
timeseries {
    appended_position_a = max(zeebe.log.appender.last.appended.position),
    processed_position_b = max(zeebe.stream.processor.last.processed.position)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
| fieldsAdd delta = appended_position_a[] - processed_position_b[]
| fieldsRemove appended_position_a, processed_position_b
3.description: Shows the processing queue size over time. Processing queue defines, what is already appended but not yet processed by the stream processor.

4.title: Batch processing command count
4.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.commands, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.commands, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.commands, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
4.description:
Show the distribution of commands in the batches over time

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

5.title: Number of batch processing retries
5.description: Shows how often we have retried batch processing due to reaching the maximum batch size.

6.title: Number of records exported but not acknowledged
6.query:
timeseries {
    exported_position_a = max(zeebe.exporter.last.exported.position),
    exported_position_b = max(zeebe.exporter.last.updated.exported.position)
  },
  by: {exporter, k8s.pod.name, partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
| fieldsAdd delta = exported_position_a[] - exported_position_b[]
| fieldsRemove exported_position_a, exported_position_b
6.description: Shows how many positions are not updated by exporters per partition. Means what is the difference between last committed exporter position and committed log position.

7.title: Processing Error Handling Phase
7.query:
timeseries error_phase = max(zeebe.stream.processor.error.handling.phase),
  by: {k8s.pod.name, partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| filter arrayMax(error_phase) > 0
7.description: Ported from Grafana: Grafana rendered this as a state timeline over `> 0`. Dynatrace has no state-timeline visualization, so the numeric phase is charted and series that never leave NO_ERROR are filtered out.

8.title: Number of records not exported
8.query:
timeseries {
    committed_position_a = max(zeebe.log.appender.last.committed.position),
    exported_position_b = max(zeebe.exporter.last.exported.position, filter:{exporter == "elasticsearch"})
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
| fieldsAdd delta = committed_position_a[] - exported_position_b[]
| fieldsRemove committed_position_a, exported_position_b
8.description: Shows how many records are not exported yet.

9.title: Last updated exported position
9.description: Shows the last exported position which was committed by the given exporter per partition.

10.title: Last appended position
10.description: Shows the position, which was appended last by the leader per partition.

11.title: Last committed position
11.description: Shows the last committed log position.

12.title: Last processed position
12.description: Shows the last processed position by the stream processor per partition.

13.title: Last replayed source position
13.description: Shows the last replayed source position by the stream processor per partition and pod

14.title: Number of records not processed
14.query:
timeseries {
    committed_position_a = max(zeebe.log.appender.last.committed.position),
    processed_position_b = max(zeebe.stream.processor.last.processed.position)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
| fieldsAdd delta = committed_position_a[] - processed_position_b[]
| fieldsRemove committed_position_a, processed_position_b
14.description: Shows how many records the stream processor has not processed yet.

15.title: Last exported position
15.description: Shows the last exported position per partition.

16.title: Processing Phase
16.description: Displays the processing phase of each node per partition.

17.title: Exporting Phase
17.description: Displays the exporting phase of each node per partition.

18.title: Banned instances by partition
18.description: Shows the count of banned process instances per partition.

19.title: Buffered Messages by partition
19.description: Shows the number of buffered messages per partition.

20.title: Scheduled command cache size
20.description: The size of the scheduled command cache, grouped by command intent.

21.content:
## Throughput
Process instance, job and record volumes.

22.title: Process Instance Events per second (range = 1m)

23.title: Job events per second (range = 1m)

24.title: Process Instance Events
24.query:
timeseries {
    process_instance = sum(zeebe.element.instance.events.total, filter:{type == "PROCESS"}),
    job = sum(zeebe.job.events.total)
  },
  by: {action},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
| fieldsAdd process_instance = arrayCumulativeSum(process_instance)
| fieldsAdd job = arrayCumulativeSum(job)
24.description: Counters arrive from Camunda as OTLP **delta** values (Dynatrace does not ingest cumulative counters), so each column is cumulated over the selected timeframe to reproduce Grafana's monotonic counter view.

25.title: Process Instance Events per second (range = 1m)
25.query:
timeseries {
    process_instance = sum(zeebe.element.instance.events.total, rate:1s, filter:{type == "PROCESS"}),
    job = sum(zeebe.job.events.total, rate:1s)
  },
  by: {action},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true

26.title: Processed Commands
26.description: Processed commands by the leading Stream Processor

27.title: Exported Records
27.description: Exported Records by the leading Stream Processor

28.title: Replayed Events
28.description: Replayed events by the following Stream Processor

29.title: Process instance creation per second
29.description: Shows the process instance creation rate over all partitions in the namespace. It will only count root process instances, so call activity process instance creations are excluded.

30.title: Process instance completion per second
30.description: Shows the process instance completion rate over all partitions in the namespace. It will only count root process instances, so call activity process instance creations are excluded.

31.title: Job creation per second
31.description: Shows the Job creation rate over all partitions in the namespace

32.title: Job completion per second
32.description: Shows the Job completion rate over all partitions in the namespace.

33.content:
## Latency
Processing, write and commit latency distributions (p50/p90/p99).

34.title: Process Instance Execution Time
34.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
34.description:
Shows the execution time of a process instance. This means the time (latency) between creating the instance and completing it.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

35.title: Process Instance Execution Time (avg)
35.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 50),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 99),
    p50_3 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 50),
    p99_4 = percentile(zeebe.process.instance.execution.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
35.description: Shows the execution time of a process instance. This means the time (latency) between creating the instance and completing it.

36.title: Job Activation Time
36.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.job.activation.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.job.activation.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.job.activation.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
36.description:
Shows the time (latency) between creating the job and activating it.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

37.title: Job Life Time
37.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.job.life.time, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.job.life.time, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.job.life.time, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
37.description:
Shows the complete lifetime of an job. This means the time (latency) between creating the job and completing it.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

38.title: Overall Processing Latency
38.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
38.description:
Shows the time (latency) between writing the command to the dispatcher and processing the record.

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

39.title: Record Processing Duration
39.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.processing.duration, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.processing.duration, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.processing.duration, 99)
  },
  by: {valueType, intent},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
39.description: Time taken to process a record

40.title: Record Processing Duration
40.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.processing.duration, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.processing.duration, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.processing.duration, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
40.description:
Time taken to process a record

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

41.title: Batch Event Replay Duration
41.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.replay.event.batch.replay.duration, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.replay.event.batch.replay.duration, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.replay.event.batch.replay.duration, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
41.description:
Time taken to replay a batch of events

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

42.title: Post commit task execution duration
42.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.post.commit.tasks, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.post.commit.tasks, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.post.commit.tasks, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
42.description:
Time spent executing post-commit tasks after batch processing (in seconds)

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

43.title: Batch processing duration (in seconds)
43.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.duration, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.duration, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.stream.processor.batch.processing.duration, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))},
  union: true
43.description:
Time spent in processing a batch of commands (excluding transaction commit, side effects, etc.)

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

44.title: Commit Latency Quantiles
44.query:
timeseries {
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency, 99),
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency, 50),
    mean = avg(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
44.description: Shows the quantiles of: time taken to commit a record to the log (includes write latency)

45.title: Record Write Quantiles
45.query:
timeseries {
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency, 99),
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency, 50),
    mean = avg(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency)
  },
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
45.description: Shows the quantiles of: time taken to append a record to the log

46.title: Commit latency
46.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.commit.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
46.description:
Time taken to commit a record to the log (includes write latency)

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

47.title: Record write latency
47.query:
timeseries {
    p50 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency, 50),
    p90 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency, 90),
    p99 = percentile(zeebe.log.appender.append.latency, 99)
  },
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(partition, array($Partition)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod))},
  union: true
47.description:
Time taken to append a record to the log

Grafana rendered this as a histogram heatmap; Dynatrace charts the p50/p90/p99 percentiles of the same histogram instead.

48.content:
## Backpressure
Request admission control on the brokers.

49.title: In flight Requests
49.description: Current number of request inflight per partition.

50.title: Total Dropped Requests
50.description: The rate of requests dropped due to backpressure per partition.

51.title: Backpressure Requests Limit
51.query:
timeseries requests_limit = sum(zeebe.backpressure.requests.limit),
  by: {partition},
  filter: {in(k8s.namespace.name, array($Namespace)) and in(k8s.pod.name, array($Pod)) and in(partition, array($Partition))}
| filter arrayMax(requests_limit) > 0
51.description:
Current limit for number of inflight requests per partition.

Ported from Grafana: Grafana restricted this to Raft leaders with `and on(...) (atomix_role == 3)`. DQL has no cross-metric join filter, so all pods are included and all-zero series (followers, which report no limit) are filtered out instead.
